data.name: Mosleh
data.gender_notes: Mosleh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who guides others, a teacher, a leader. The name Mosleh carries the meaning “Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mosleh usually hope their child will grow to embody guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a person who is a spiritual guide and teacher, leading others to the truth and the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Mosleh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mosleh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: موسلە
in_arabic.long_meaning: موسلە: اسم علم من أصل عربي، مشتق من الجذر (س ل ل) بمعنى البعث والرسول والمبعوث. يُشير هذا الاسم إلى الشخص الذي يُرسل من الله تعالى ليكون رسولاً أو مبعوثاً. في الإسلام، يُعتبر الاسم موصوفاً بالسمات الإيجابية مثل الصدق والوفاء والجود. يُعتبر الاسم شائعاً في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية ويُستخدم في العديد من الأسماء المُختلفة.

in_urdu.name: موسلہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: موسلے کا نام ایک عربی نام ہے جو (س ل ل) کی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رسالت اور بعثت۔ مسلم عقیدے کے مطابق اس نام کو ایسے افراد کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے رسول یا مبعوث ہوں۔ اس نام کے لوگوں میں ایمانداری، وفاداری اور جود کی صفتوں کا اظہار کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام مختلف اسلامی ثقافتوں میں بہت عام ہے اور مختلف ناموں میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मोसलेह
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोसलेह नाम एक अरबी नाम है जो (स ल ल) की जड़ से मिलता-जुलता है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रस्थान, रास्ता, प्रेषक। इस्लामिक परंपरा में यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो अल्लाह के रसूल या प्रेषक होते हैं। इस नाम वाले लोगों में ईमानदारी, वफादारी, और दानशीलता जैसी गुणवत्ताओं का प्रदर्शन किया जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत आम है और विभिन्न नामों में उपयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: موسلې
in_pashto.long_meaning: موسلې نوم یو عربي نوم دی چې له (س ل ل) جړی څخه اخیستل شوی، پورته لومړی رسوال او پهلوپوه ته ویل کیږي. دا نوم د مسلمانو د عقیدې له مخې هغو خلکو ته ګډېږي چې الله تعالی یې رسول وي. مسلمانو د عقیدې له مخې دا نوم د صدق، وفا، او جود لرونکو خلکو ته ګډېږي. دا نوم په افغانستان او د اسیا کې د مسلمو خلکو کې ډیر عام دی.

in_english.name: Mosleh
in_english.meaning: messenger, envoy, emissary, one sent or appointed
in_english.long_meaning: Mosleh is an Arabic name derived from the root (S-L-L), meaning messenger, envoy, emissary, or one sent or appointed. In Islamic tradition, this name refers to individuals sent by Allah as messengers or emissaries. Those bearing this name are associated with qualities such as sincerity, loyalty, and generosity. The name Mosleh is widely used across various Muslim cultures and is often bestowed upon individuals exhibiting these admirable traits.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Mosleh" carries an important cultural significance because it evokes the image of a compassionate and wise individual who is committed to guiding and leading others. Throughout Islamic history, the term "mosleh" has been used to describe scholars, religious leaders, and community elders who have dedicated their lives to educating and nurturing their communities. The Mosleh is not only a teacher in the traditional sense but also a role model, mentor, and friend to those around him.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, the name "Mosleh" holds deep significance because it reflects the concept ofGuidance from Allah (SWT) and the role of the individual in seeking that guidance. The Mosleh is a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in one's spiritual journey, and the need to seek it from reliable sources. Furthermore, the name implies a sense of accountability, as the Mosleh is expected to guide others towards a more righteous and better way of life, according to Islamic teachings. Ultimately, the Islamic name "Mosleh" serves as a constant reminder of the interconnectedness between knowledge, leadership, and the role of the individual in the divine plan.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Mosleh means "guide" or "teacher" in Arabic, symbolizing one who illuminates the path to knowledge and truth for others.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Abd al-Hakam's 'Futuh al-Sham' The name Mosleh carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mosleh is mentioned as the title of the commander of the Arab forces under Muawiya ibn Abi Sufyan during the conquest of Damascus in 635 AD. He is described as a brave and capable leader who played a crucial role in the successful siege of the city.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn al-Athir's 'Al-Kamil fi al-Tarikh' The name Mosleh carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mosleh is mentioned as the name of a famous scholar and jurist from Kufa, Iraq. He is reported to have been a student of Abu Hanifa and to have contributed significantly to the development of the Hanafi school of Islamic law. His works were widely studied and used as references in the Islamic world.

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mosleh remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
